decisions.reason: The IMU module sits squarely within the firm's sensor-module expertise and moved up to a dedicated page in 2024, showing the firm can interpret its results and is investing in it.
The industrial AC input module builds directly on the firm's measurement and industrial know-how and has had a stable dedicated page since launch, so it is a core platform element.

The solid state relay module is a natural extension of the firm's existing relay and control modules, and the in-house hardware and firmware design makes it cheap to maintain, though the move to newer connectors could later prompt a successor version.
The RGB LED control module uses the firm's established LED driver and API knowledge, so it fits the modular system and the firm has the absorptive capacity to refine it.

The remote access service supports the strategic expansion of the wallbox and energy-management line and builds on the firm's growing software and networking competence, making it worth developing further.
